title: HF1089 (2023-2024 Regular): Ownership, possession, and operation of short-barreled shotguns excluded from criminal violation; ownership and possession of machine guns or short-barreled shotguns by dealers and manufacturers modified.

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Minnesota) (gun-policy Stage 5, Minnesota); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Minnesota text (Introduction, 2023-01-30; official copy, https://www.revisor.mn.gov/bills/93/2023/0/HF/1089/versions/0/)
provenance.note: As filed Jan 30, 2023. Section 1 strikes short-barreled shotguns from the offence; Section 2 strikes the peace-officer-training or sale-to-agencies condition on licensed dealers and manufacturers. Section 2 clause (5) is quoted with struck words left out.

operative_text:
Section 1 (Minn. Stat. 609.67, subd. 2): Except as otherwise provided herein, whoever owns, possesses, or operates a machine gun or any trigger activator or machine gun conversion kit may be sentenced to imprisonment for not more than five years or to payment of a fine of not more than $10,000, or both.
